references.text: The Lord said to Aaron that he should have no inheritance in the land, for the Lord himself is his inheritance among the people of Israel.
The Levites shall have no inheritance among the people of Israel, but the tithe that the Israelites give to the Lord shall be their inheritance.
Only the tribe of Levi was given no inheritance by Moses, for the fire offerings of the Lord, the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as he had said to them.
The tribe of Levi was given no inheritance by Moses, for the Lord, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he had said to them.
The Levites have no share among you, for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance.
The priests shall have no inheritance, for the Lord says: I am your inheritance.
The Lord is my portion and my cup; you hold my lot in your hand. A pleasant heritage has fallen to me in beautiful places.
Even if my flesh and my heart fail, yet God is the rock of my heart and my portion forever.
